not_submitted.title: Verify your identity
not_submitted.body: Upload your documents below, then submit them for review.

pending.title: Under review
pending.body: Your documents are being checked. You can't change them until the review is finished.

rejected.title: Changes needed
rejected.body: Your documents were not approved. Fix the issue below and submit again.

addressCard.title: Add your address
addressCard.hint: Reviewers check it along with your documents, so it's needed before you submit.

identity.hintRequired: Upload at least one. Cards need both sides. Once one is complete, the others are optional.
identity.hintOptional: Optional. Your driving license is your identity document, but you can add these too.

optionalSection.title: Optional Documents
optionalSection.hint: Not needed to get verified, but they help.

alerts.fileTooLargeMessage: Documents must be 10 MB or smaller
alerts.submittedMessage: You'll be able to see the result here once your documents are checked.

verificationPrompt.title: Identity verification required
verificationPrompt.noteRejected: Your documents need changes before they can be approved.
